subject: Invitation to Annual Company Networking Event
body: Dear [Recipient], We are delighted to invite you to our annual company networking event on Friday, December 10th at 6:00 PM. Join us for an evening of networking, entertainment, and delicious food at the Grand Hotel Ballroom. Please RSVP by December 3rd to secure your spot. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Your Name]
